ratings_why.fun: Every last gold is a choice between rolling over a Fanfare and keeping a Reserve, and Sealer, Borrower, Fennimore and Tithonus chain in ways that change with board order.
ratings_why.distinct: Holding gold as a resource that competes with spending it is new; the fight side is mostly +1/+1s, and spend-gold payoffs exist elsewhere.

verdict_why: The towns aren't marked on any unit and Fennimore's reach is unclear, so town buffs and threshold tricks can't be read yet.

points.text: No unit says whether it is Hive, Carnival or Road, yet Old Messor, Maestro Tettix, Signora Afide and Madame Cigale buff by town. Mark each unit's town.
Next to Old Messor, does Lord Fennimore also lower 'for each 4 gold', and next to Tithonus is the second Fanfare at double the lowered number? Say which numbers he changes.
Once the float is banked, the Hive stops deciding. A Hive card that pays for emptying the jar (the cluster breaks into the field) would make the crossing a Hive choice too, not only a Carnival one.

Wax Sealer is the only card that moves gold from Purse to Spent, and it's the best puzzle here. One or two more Road bridges, such as a refund that lands in the Purse, would give Ottavia and Afide more to play with.
Signora Afide fits Ottavia's balanced build well (8 spent and 8 held fires both). Saying so in a build would show players why she's there.

standouts.why: A Hive card whose gold counts as Spent: it feeds Bandstand Horn, Tettix and Ottavia's balance depending on where it sits.
Free gold for the broke, a tax for savers, beyond-income gold for Cigale, and a reading-order puzzle against Reserve units.
The smaller of two numbers makes every buy and every save matter at once.

weakest.why: One obvious job, capped at 3 gold, with nothing to combo with.
Plain Health from the Purse; the same read as Comb Guard with no twist.

flags.note: With Old Messor on a 16-gold float, Mother Melissa gives every Hive unit +8/+8 a turn for free, forever.
A banked 20-gold float makes Comptroller Gravelle deal 30 damage every fight at no ongoing cost.
A 20-gold drain turn fires Madame Cigale 20 times across all Carnival units.
Which numbers Lord Fennimore lowers on Old Messor and with Tithonus isn't stated.
